dial_style: Beige dial per Timex India (Timex.com says cream), full Arabic numerals per Timex.com
best_for: Leather-strap watch with an Indiglo light
verdict: A leather-strap watch with full Arabic numerals and an Indiglo light (per Timex.com), in Timex's Easy Reader range.
paragraphs: The 38 mm case is brass in a gold tone, with a beige dial (Timex India; Timex.com says cream), full Arabic numerals (Timex.com) and a brown leather strap.

Timex.com lists a quartz movement, a CR2016 battery and the Indiglo backlight, which lets you tell the time in the dark with the push of a button. Timex India lists a one-year warranty against manufacturer defects. The Timex India page does not mention the Indiglo light.
Timex lists 30 m water resistance on this model. Timex.com adds that it is suitable only for hand-washing or accidental splashes of water, not for swimming or diving.
good: Beige dial per Timex India (Timex.com says cream)
Indiglo light for reading the time in the dark, per Timex.com
Leather strap with a buckle, per the listings
1 year warranty against manufacturer defects, per Timex India
not_good: Timex.com says the 30 m rating is suitable only for hand-washing or accidental splashes of water, not for swimming or diving
Timex India says there is no warranty on leather straps
Timex India shows the model code as TW2P75800UJ, with a UJ ending
